New material: Qazvin, Zanjan (2006, VNPC, VN). General distribution. Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Iran, Kirgizia, Syria, Turkmenistan.
NE-Brazil (Pernambuco, Bahia); WC-Brazil (Goiás); SE-Brazil (Espírito Santo, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro)
DISTRIBUTION: N. Mozambique to S. Kenya.

Distribution. Described from the Eurasian beaver (undetermined subspecies) from unknown locality in Europe (Fain & Lukoschus 1985), from C. f. orientoeuropaeus from Russia (Voronezh Reserve) (Bochkov & Dubinina 2011), and from C. f. belorussicus from Poland (Suwałki) (present paper).
Distribution in Iran. Hormozgan, Kerman, Sistan & Baluchestan (Hoberlandt 1997), Iran (no locality cited) (Rider 2006). General distribution. Egypt, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopian Region.
